summary: Read a one-way linked list in which every node stores an integer. Walk from the front to the back to obtain a sequence of integers. Write true when that sequence matches the sequence obtained by walking from the back to the front, and write false when it does not. An empty list and a list of one node both produce true. Compare the integers in the nodes, not the place of a node in memory.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a node count followed by the integer stored in each node.
